records.statement: Coinbase's Q3 2026 GAAP net income of $718.697M included $715.022M gains on crypto assets held for investment, primarily fair-value remeasurement of BTC and ETH. Q3 revenue fell 35% YoY, transaction revenue 44%, subscription/services 20%, and Adjusted EBITDA 58%; adjusted net income was approximately $77.7M. Do not treat GAAP net income or investment marks as recurring trading revenue or XRP demand.

Coinbase's Q3 10-Q reports approximately $1.3B crypto assets held as collateral and $389.7M crypto assets borrowed, but does not disclose token-level composition. BTC and ETH investment holdings are itemized; approximately $314M of other crypto is aggregated, with no individual other-crypto position above 5% of total investment fair value. XRP-specific proprietary holdings and collateral balances remain unknown.

Coinbase's Q3 10.7% crypto trading-volume market-share series was adjusted to include stablecoin-conversion activity. It is not directly comparable to spot/derivatives-only exchange-volume shares unless peer methodologies and competitor sets are aligned.
